item.title: Labour Department Samba hosts one-day awareness camp on New Labour Codes
item.description: SAMBA: The Labour Department Samba organised a one-day awareness and interactive programme on the New Labour Codes today in the Baribrahmana Association Hall. item.title: 85 Village Defence Guards from Border Areas Undergo Intensive Training in Jammu
item.description: JAMMU: Around 85 members of the Village Defence Group (VDG) from remote border villages are undergoing intensive training in Jammu to enhance their operational preparedness, police said on Saturday. item.title: J&K Police Book Seven Landlords in Jammu for Keeping Tenants Without Verification
item.description: JAMMU: Jammu and Kashmir Police on Saturday booked seven landlords in Jammu for allegedly keeping tenants in their premises without mandatory police verification, officials said. The action was taken as part of an intensified tenant verification drive in view of the upcoming Republic Day celebrations, aimed at strengthening security arrangements across the city. item.title: Jammu DM Bars Courier Services from Transporting Narcotics Without Permit, Orders Police Verification of Staff
item.description: JAMMU: Authorities in Jammu have barred courier companies and parcel services from transporting narcotic drugs, psychotropic substances and other contraband without a valid permit, and directed them to ensure mandatory police verification of all employees.
